title: engineer-pm-touchpoint-sprint-intake-elena
body:
Context: Quick prep for my weekly 1:1 with Kyra (eng lead). Goal is to align on urgent reliability work, finalize scope for console rollout tasks next sprint, and clarify Dedicated autoscale behavior so we can communicate SLA impact to sales folks.

Meeting logistics
- Time: 30m
- Date: 2025-03-12
- Mode: huddle / informal (video optional)
- Primary outcome: commit owners + next steps for 3 top items

Agenda (30 min total)
1) Incident summary & quick mitigation (8m)
   - What: yesterday transient latency spike on hosted-api region-us-west (p95 jumped from 110ms -> 480ms for ~20m)
   - Suspected cause: routing fallback cascade + a backlog-induced batching spike hitting small models on shared pool
   - Ask for Kyra: confirm immediate mitigations (throttle fallback, temp-pin to larger variant), estimate timeline for full root cause (logs + trace analysis)
   - Desired outcome: mitigation validated and owner (Ravi) has 24h debug window

2) Console rollout items: per-route dashboards + tracing hooks (8m)
   - Status: frontend work done, backend telemetry needs sanity checks (token-level breakdown, sampled traces)
   - Risk: metrics cardinality explosion if we emit per-token labels for every route
   - Proposal: enable per-route token sampling at 1% by default, escalate for VIP routes
   - Ask: Kyra to prioritize check on retention config and SLI thresholds, agree on rollout canary (10% internal first)
   - Outcome: canary date + rollback criteria

3) Dedicated autoscale / burst behavior (7m)
   - Problem: customers on Dedicated seeing cold-start latency during burst because reserved pool autoscale delay is 60s
   - Options discussed: reduce autoscale window, allow warm standbys, or pre-warm via traffic prediction for top customers
   - Tradeoffs: cost vs SLA; need to map to sales commitments
   - Action: decide quick fix (reduce to 30s) vs longer-term (predictive pre-warm). Kyra to assess infra risk and estimate $$ delta.

4) Private (VPC) onboarding checklist improvements (4m)
   - Recurring friction: KMS provisioning + audit log onboarding tends to block deliveries by 7–10 days
   - Quick wins: provide terraform templates + a validated KMS playbook; solution engineering to run a dry run
   - Outcome: owner (me) will draft template, Kyra to assign an SE to run dry run with one queued customer

Wrap / parking lot (3m)
- Revisit model-routing fallback policies and how they interact with KV cache warming
- Budget ask for next quarter: small pool for pre-warm capacity for top 10 enterprise customers (I’ll bring draft numbers next 1:1)

Follow-ups / action items (clear owners and due dates)
- Ravi Menon: gather traces & top 5 request examples from incident, initial RCA draft (due 2025-03-13)
- Kyra Malik: sign off on console canary plan and rollback criteria, set canary start date (due 2025-03-14)
- Elena Vasquez (me): draft terraform KMS template + onboarding checklist, put in repo under private-deployments/templates (due 2025-03-18)
- Kyra Malik / Infra: evaluate autoscale window reduction risk and rough cost delta for warm standbys (due 2025-03-17)
- Product ops: update customer-facing runbook for dedicated burst behavior (owner TBD, due 2025-03-21)

Notes to self / talking points
- Emphasize: customers tolerate small rolling restarts but not 2–5s tail latencies that break UI flows
- Ask Kyra to quantify impact in token-cost terms for the pre-warm proposal (makes it easier to get finance sign-off)
- Keep canary small and instrumented; prefer short canary with clear rollback condition rather than long ambiguous try

Unresolved questions
- Do we have an automatic knob to throttle fallback cascades based on queue depth per model? (if not, file backlog)
- What is the current SLO window we promise for Dedicated under burst? Need exact wording for sales one-pager

Raw links / references I might need in the meeting
- Incident dashboard: https://analytics.redwood.internal/d/incident-msgs/latency-spike-20250311
- PR for console telemetry: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/891
- Autoscale thread Slack: slack://channels/C0458T7GH/autoscale-discuss

Tone / approach
- Collaborative, avoid micro-managing infra decisions. Focus on measurable outcomes and short deadlines to keep momentum.
- Offer to help with customer comms once we have rollback wording.

End of notes.
